svg.aria-label: Neural-SLAM-Zero. Self-supervised loop closure with zero-cost open data. Jan 2026 - now. Developing a self-supervised graph-transformer module to correct SLAM drift, targeting a >40% reduction in Absolute Trajectory Error across benchmark datasets. Integrated SLAM factor-graph data with DINOv2 image embeddings for loop-closure confidence and 6-DoF pose corrections, with runtime overhead under 15 ms on a Jetson Orin Nano. Secured institutional funding under the IFPS scheme at SSN College of Engineering.
